scope: Exactly the four staged delivery documentation/CI files listed in scanned_files. Original main-history and source/worktree publication scans remain in the referenced original audit; no history repetition. Audit output itself is metadata only and excluded from recursive self-scan.

rule_definitions.private_key_header: -----BEGIN(?: RSA| DSA| EC| OPENSSH| ENCRYPTED)? PRIVATE KEY-----
rule_definitions.private_runtime_path: Tracked path components assets/state/scratch/knowledge/_staging; config.local.toml/.env; extensions .sqlite3/.sqlite/.db/.secret/.jsonl. knowledge/.gitkeep allowed only as an empty tracked sentinel; its content is not read.

classification_policy: Prior path/rule/line classifications require the exact captured-byte Git blob hash or a recomputed LF/CRLF-equivalent exact blob hash (older audits captured raw CRLF worktree bytes while Git stores canonical LF). Newly detected Discord-shaped matches must be entirely within an exact qualified unittest identifier whose module/class/test method exists in current public test AST; no whole-directory or token-prefix exemptions.

documentation_local_links.scope: Local Markdown file targets only; future audit output target included. Remote Markdown links and anchors are not separately fetched.

limitations: Finite credential-shape/path rules and exact supplemental scope. Arbitrary secrets, external releases/artifacts and later changes are not certified. Public GitHub API conclusions verify offline workflow/step outcomes; actual model/Discord exchange, loaded service and semantic classification/recall quality remain unvalidated.
